sentences.en: And worker leverage is gone because the platform has fragmented its workforce into gig laborers who can't collectively bargain.
sentences.zh: 工人的议价能力消失了，因为平台将其劳动力碎片化为无法集体谈判的零工劳动者。

sentences.en: Any of this sound familiar?
sentences.zh: 这一切听起来耳熟吗？

sentences.en: Your consumer alternatives are gone because the platform has structured the network so that leaving costs more than staying.
sentences.zh: 你的消费者选择消失了，因为平台构建了网络，使得离开的成本高于留下的成本。

sentences.en: And then once all four constraints are eliminated, the platform is free to be as bad as it wants.
sentences.zh: 一旦这四个约束条件都被消除，平台就可以随心所欲地变坏。

sentences.en: And it will be as bad as it wants because the people who run the platforms are not bad people in some special sense.
sentences.zh: 而且它会随心所欲地变坏，因为运营平台的人并不是某种特殊意义上的坏人。

sentences.en: They are responding to an environmental reward to being terrible to you as a customer in order to make more money for a company.
sentences.zh: 他们是在响应一种环境奖励，即为了给公司赚更多的钱而对你这个客户表现得糟糕。

sentences.en: And American mental health care has gone through scary parallels to that.
sentences.zh: 而美国的心理健康护理也经历了与此惊人相似的过程。

sentences.en: We're not as far along as Google, but it's a similar system.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有像谷歌那样走得那么远，但这是一个类似的系统。

sentences.en: American health care, American education as a privatized increasingly service.
sentences.zh: 美国医疗保健，作为一种日益私有化的服务，美国教育也是如此。

sentences.en: You know, the four constraints that should have prevented this have been eliminated in the same ways.
sentences.zh: 你知道，本应防止这种情况发生的四个约束条件已经以同样的方式被消除了。

sentences.en: Competition is gone.
sentences.zh: 竞争消失了。

sentences.en: Thousands of insurance carriers became a small number of national carriers.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的保险公司变成了少数几家全国性保险公司。

sentences.en: They don't compete with each other in meaningful ways on the, you know, quality of mental health coverage.
sentences.zh: 它们在心理健康覆盖范围的质量上并没有以有意义的方式相互竞争。

sentences.en: They have arrived by parallel calculation, you know, at the same protocols.
sentences.zh: 它们通过平行计算，你知道，得出了相同的协议。

sentences.en: Twelve sessions, CBT preferred.
sentences.zh: 十二次会谈，首选CBT。

sentences.en: Medical necessity reviews at session 10.
sentences.zh: 在第10次会谈时进行医疗必要性审查。

sentences.en: Prior authorization for anything beyond manualized brief therapy.
sentences.zh: 对任何超出手册化简短疗法的内容进行预先授权。

sentences.en: You know, the pharmacy benefit managers do the same dance with medications.
sentences.zh: 你知道，药房福利管理机构在药物方面也跳着同样的舞。

sentences.en: The credentialing pathways are controlled by a small number of accrediting bodies that have arrived at the same curriculum.
sentences.zh: 认证途径由少数几个达成相同课程设置的认证机构控制。

sentences.en: CBT codes are negotiated by the AMA's relative value scale update committee.
sentences.zh: CBT代码由美国医学会（AMA）的相对价值量表更新委员会协商确定。

sentences.en: There's a million things that I could do.
sentences.zh: 我能做的事情有一百万件。

sentences.en: And last time I mentioned the RUC, a psychiatrist emailed me and told me that our country's medical policy was a conspiracy theory that I made up.
sentences.zh: 上次我提到RUC时，一位精神科医生给我发邮件，说我们国家的医疗政策是我编造的阴谋论。

sentences.en: And he should know because he was a professor emeritus and he would have heard about something like that, which is, or should be scary.
sentences.zh: 他应该知道，因为他是一位名誉教授，他本应该听说过类似的事情，这本身就是，或者应该是非常可怕的。

sentences.en: Should be scary to anyone listening.
sentences.zh: 这对任何听众来说都应该感到可怕。

sentences.en: Uh, that, that is the state of the field, but there's no competing system.
sentences.zh: 呃，这就是该领域的现状，但没有竞争系统。

sentences.en: There's no alternative market.
sentences.zh: 没有替代市场。

sentences.en: You know, if you want to use your insurance to get mental health care in America in 2026, the system you encounter is structurally identical,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你想在2026年的美国使用保险来获得心理健康护理，你所遇到的系统在结构上是完全相同的，

sentences.en: regardless of which insurance card you carry.
sentences.zh: 无论你持有哪张保险卡。

sentences.en: Well, I guess you could not have insurance, but I mean, that's just to be rich, you know, get out of jail free card.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想你可以选择没有保险，但我的意思是，那只是为了有钱人准备的，你知道，一张免费出狱卡。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Um, you know, regulatory capture is gone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，监管捕获已经完成了。

sentences.en: And I mean, the regulators who should be policing the apparatus have been so thoroughly captured by it that the regulation has become a form of cooperation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，本应监管这套机制的监管者已经被它彻底捕获，以至于监管已经变成了一种合作形式。

sentences.en: And the agencies that should be enforcing mental health parity have been so defanged that the mental health parity and addiction equity act of 2008 functions in practice as a suggestion.
sentences.zh: 本应强制执行心理健康平等的机构已经被削弱，以至于2008年的《心理健康平等与成瘾公平法案》在实践中仅起到建议的作用。

sentences.en: And the licensing boards that should be policing clinician quality have been captured by the professional self-interest and now function primarily as gatekeepers protecting current practitioners from competing rather than ensuring patient quality.
sentences.zh: 本应监管临床医生质量的许可委员会已经被专业利益所捕获，现在主要作为守门人，保护现有从业者免受竞争，而不是确保患者质量。

sentences.en: You know, the joint commissions behavioral health standards have been written in consultation with the institutions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，联合委员会的行为健康标准是在与这些机构协商后编写的。

sentences.en: The standards are supposed to regulate and the accreditation bodies for graduate training programs operate on a fee for service model in which the accredited programs pay the accreditor,
sentences.zh: 这些标准本应进行监管，而研究生培训项目的认证机构以按服务收费的模式运作，认证项目向认证机构付费，

sentences.en: which produces exactly the conflict of interest that you would expect.
sentences.zh: 这产生了你所预料到的那种利益冲突。

sentences.en: And the FDA,
sentences.zh: 还有FDA（美国食品药品监督管理局），

sentences.en: which sets the framework for what can be prescribed and how operates inside an industry funded user fee structure that has not been seriously reformed in three decades.
sentences.zh: 它设定了处方内容和方式的框架，却在一个行业资助的用户费结构内运作，该结构在过去三十年里从未进行过认真的改革。

sentences.en: But if you follow those rules and you pay that ethics commission, you are ethical and you are evidence-based.
sentences.zh: 但如果你遵循那些规则并向道德委员会缴费，你就是合乎道德且基于证据的。

sentences.en: Worker leverage is gone.
sentences.zh: 劳动者的议价能力已经丧失。

sentences.en: Clinicians are no longer in a position to collectively refuse the conditions of the work.
sentences.zh: 临床医生已无法再集体拒绝工作条件。

sentences.en: The credentialing pathways have been atomized across multiple licenses, none of which gives clinicians enough collective power to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 认证途径被分散到多个执照中，没有哪一个能赋予临床医生足够的集体力量去进行谈判。

sentences.en: Insurance reimbursement rates are set unilaterally and clinicians have no leverage to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 保险报销费率是单方面设定的，临床医生没有任何谈判筹码。

sentences.en: The administrative burden has expanded to the point that solo practice is barely viable financially,
sentences.zh: 行政负担已经膨胀到个人执业在经济上几乎无法维持的地步，

sentences.en: forcing clinicians into group practices and health systems that further reduce their autonomy.
sentences.zh: 迫使临床医生进入团体执业和医疗系统，这进一步削弱了他们的自主权。

sentences.en: The few unionization attempts in mental health, primarily at large hospital systems and digital platforms have been met with the standard playbook of corporate union busting.
sentences.zh: 心理健康领域仅有的几次工会化尝试，主要是在大型医院系统和数字平台上，都遭到了企业破坏工会的标准手段。

sentences.en: And also it's illegal for private practice therapists to form any sort of union.
sentences.zh: 而且，私人执业治疗师组建任何形式的工会都是违法的。

sentences.en: That would be considered a cartel.
sentences.zh: 那会被视为卡特尔（垄断组织）。

sentences.en: You know, when the AMA does it with the RUC, they get a pass.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当美国医学会（AMA）通过相对价值更新委员会（RUC）做这件事时，他们却能获得豁免。

sentences.en: Anyone else does that, it's a cartel under the law.
sentences.zh: 其他人这样做，在法律上就是卡特尔。

sentences.en: And the result is that clinicians cannot collectively refuse the apparatuses condition and individual clinicians who refuse end up financially priced out of the field and patient alternatives are gone structurally.
sentences.zh: 结果就是临床医生无法集体拒绝这种机制的条件，而拒绝的个人临床医生最终会在经济上被挤出该领域，患者的选择在结构上也消失了。

sentences.en: You know, the ghost network problem, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那个“幽灵网络”问题，你知道，

sentences.en: the insurance companies pretend to have these robust networks just by not really checking who in them is still alive or taking new patients.
sentences.zh: 保险公司假装拥有这些强大的网络，只是因为他们并没有真正核实网络里的人是否还活着，或者是否在接收新患者。

sentences.en: You know, the in-network provider directories are full of clinicians who are not actually accepting patients.
sentences.zh: 你知道，网络内的提供者名录里全是实际上并不接收患者的临床医生。

sentences.en: And, you know, the patient who tries to find care and network discovers that the directory is actually a fiction and that no one does any of the things that, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，试图在网络内寻找护理的患者会发现名录其实是虚构的，而且没有人做任何，你知道，

sentences.en: evidence-based medicine says would treat the thing that they have.
sentences.zh: 循证医学所说能治疗他们病症的事情。

sentences.en: They're kind of full of these certain types of clinicians.
sentences.zh: 名录里充斥着这类特定的临床医生。

sentences.en: And the patient who looks for alternatives outside the medical system finds this unregulated wilderness of life coaches and app-based wellness products and scams and abuse,
sentences.zh: 而寻找医疗系统外替代方案的患者，会发现这是一个不受监管的荒野，充满了生活教练、基于应用程序的健康产品、骗局和虐待，

sentences.en: you know, a lot of times.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多时候都是这样。

sentences.en: And the apparatus has structured the field so that there is no real exit for the patient.
sentences.zh: 而且这种机制已经构建了该领域，使得患者没有真正的出路。

sentences.en: So you have the same four conditions that produce insidification on a digital platform,
sentences.zh: 所以你有导致数字平台上出现“内化”（insidification）的四个相同条件，

sentences.en: and all four of them are present in the mental health care and largely the health care sector in this country.
sentences.zh: 而这四个条件在我国的心理健康护理乃至整个医疗保健行业中都存在。

sentences.en: And the result is the same.
sentences.zh: 结果也是一样的。

sentences.en: The product gets systematically worse.
sentences.zh: 产品在系统性地变差。

sentences.en: The clinicians spend more time on documentation and less time with the patient.
sentences.zh: 临床医生花在文书工作上的时间更多，花在患者身上的时间更少。

sentences.en: And if you look at how this thing worked, we didn't focus on this super closely, but in the 80s,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这件事是如何运作的，我们并没有非常仔细地关注这一点，但在80年代，

sentences.en: when this was sold as freedom and they went after the patients and the patients got pissed in the 90s.
sentences.zh: 当这被当作自由兜售时，他们针对的是患者，而患者在90年代感到愤怒。

sentences.en: So they went after the businesses.
sentences.zh: 于是他们转而针对企业。

sentences.en: And then after they went after the businesses and they had them, they said, you can't leave.
sentences.zh: 然后当他们针对企业并控制了企业后，他们说，你不能离开。

sentences.en: It's too expensive and there's nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 因为成本太高，而且无处可去。

sentences.en: And then the businesses and the patients were stuck.
sentences.zh: 于是企业和患者都被困住了。

sentences.en: And the machine kept going.
sentences.zh: 机器继续运转。

sentences.en: It didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 这无关紧要。

sentences.en: Even though everybody was in agreement, largely, that it was bad.
sentences.zh: 尽管大家在很大程度上都同意这是糟糕的。

sentences.en: What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你能做什么呢？

sentences.en: And the cruelest piece, which, you know, doctoral names, you know, when he's talking about insidification and his writing is that clinicians who absorb, I mean,
sentences.zh: 最残酷的部分，你知道，博士的名字，你知道，当他在谈论“内化”和他的写作时，是那些吸收了——我是说，

sentences.en: he's talking about tech, not clinicians, but he says this thing.
sentences.zh: 他在谈论科技，而不是临床医生，但他说了这件事。

sentences.en: You know, clinicians who absorb the financial and moral costs of insidification, the people who are the ones who are in the crumple zone.
sentences.zh: 你知道，吸收了“内化”带来的经济和道德成本的临床医生，那些处于“溃缩区”的人。

sentences.en: They're not the people who designed it.
sentences.zh: 他们不是设计它的人。

sentences.en: They're in a system that extracts the value of their labor while making them carry the blame for failure.
sentences.zh: 他们身处一个榨取他们劳动价值，同时让他们承担失败责任的系统中。

sentences.en: We talked about some of the meeting making apparatuses in America and when they died in the Industrial Revolution in the 40s and the 50s and the 60s.
sentences.zh: 我们谈到了美国的一些意义构建机制，以及它们在工业革命时期，在40年代、50年代和60年代是如何消亡的。

sentences.en: And the reverence is now, you know,
sentences.zh: 而现在的崇敬，你知道，

sentences.en: supposed to be given to this one institution because it's positioned itself as the legitimate inheritor of all the cultural roles that used to be filled by all this other stuff.
sentences.zh: 本应给予这个机构，因为它将自己定位为所有文化角色的合法继承者，而这些角色过去是由所有其他事物来填充的。

sentences.en: Which, you know, granted, had some problems and wasn't scientific, but it wasn't supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 当然，这确实有一些问题，而且并不科学，但它本就不应该是科学的。

sentences.en: It was priests and elders and unions and traditional healers and, you know,
sentences.zh: 那是牧师、长者、工会、传统治疗师，以及，你知道，

sentences.en: the nature of a family structure that the profit motive and the material conditions made more room for than they do now.
sentences.zh: 家庭结构的本质，利润动机和物质条件为它留出的空间比现在要多。

sentences.en: You know, the easiest people to make liable are probably the schools for the clinicians they produce,
sentences.zh: 你知道，最容易追究责任的人可能就是培养这些临床医生的学校，

sentences.en: which right now they're pretty protected by being diploma mills in a lot of cases or just not being terribly concerned with the outcomes of who they graduate.
sentences.zh: 目前它们在很多情况下受到保护，因为它们是文凭工厂，或者只是不太关心毕业生的成果。

sentences.en: You also could remove the sovereign immunity from some licensing boards and see if the types of people that are on the boards now still want to be on them if they had a little bit of skin in the game.
sentences.zh: 你也可以取消一些执照委员会的主权豁免权，看看现在委员会里的那些人，如果他们自己也承担一点风险，是否还想留在里面。

sentences.en: Because my guess is that they wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 因为我猜他们不会。

sentences.en: You would get people who maybe had a vision for getting rid of people, which would cause some money to not go to places that it's supposed to go, which is why we don't do that.
sentences.zh: 你会得到一些可能有愿景去淘汰某些人的人，这会导致一些钱不会流向本该流向的地方，这就是为什么我们不那样做。

sentences.en: It's why we don't have accountability in that way.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们没有那样的问责制。

sentences.en: You have to be willing to say things like, there is no ethical way to work inside of this system.
sentences.zh: 你必须愿意说出这样的话：在这个系统内部工作没有合乎道德的方式。

sentences.en: There is no ethical way to work for this kind of business.
sentences.zh: 为这种企业工作没有合乎道德的方式。

sentences.en: Um, and a lot of the businesses that send me emails as a social worker wanting to be a good worker.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很多给我发邮件的企业，作为一名想成为好员工的社会工作者。

sentences.en: There are things in the terms of service for the client that are unethical, if not illegal for me to do as a social worker.
sentences.zh: 客户的服务条款中有些事情是不道德的，如果不是我作为社会工作者做这些事违法的话。

sentences.en: Now, maybe a clinical psychologist or some, a different kind of license could do it, but that's not enforced.
sentences.zh: 现在，也许临床心理学家或某种不同类型的执照持有者可以做，但这并没有被强制执行。

sentences.en: I mean, we easily could say this company, no social worker can ethically work for.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们可以很容易地说，这家公司，没有社会工作者可以合乎道德地为它工作。

sentences.en: If they do, their license can be taken.
sentences.zh: 如果他们这样做，他们的执照可能会被吊销。

sentences.en: And now this company cannot hire social workers.
sentences.zh: 现在这家公司就无法雇佣社会工作者了。

sentences.en: And if you do that, um, I think, well, I think there's a reason why we don't do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你这样做，嗯，我想，好吧，我想我们不这样做是有原因的。

sentences.en: And you have to prepare for the thing that will survive the AI displacement to be the thing that was never fungible in the first place.
sentences.zh: 你必须为那些在人工智能取代中幸存下来的事物做好准备，这些事物从一开始就是不可替代的。

sentences.en: The clinician who could sit with another nervous system and read the dimensional profile in real time and weight the layers and notice the autonomic shift in the room and integrate the trauma context with the attachment history and the cultural framing and with the symbolic content of the dream the patient brought in.
sentences.zh: 那位能与另一个神经系统坐在一起，实时读取维度特征，权衡各层级，注意到房间里的自主神经变化，并将创伤背景与依恋历史、文化框架以及患者带来的梦境中的象征内容整合在一起的临床医生。

sentences.en: And I don't think that AI can do this technically, even if it can do it intellectually some of the time,
sentences.zh: 我不认为人工智能在技术上能做到这一点，即使它有时在智力上能做到，

sentences.en: because the AI is not able to read the nervous system of the patient in the way that skilled clinicians, whether or not they knew they're doing somatic work, see posture,
sentences.zh: 因为人工智能无法像熟练的临床医生那样读取患者的神经系统，无论他们是否知道自己在做躯体工作，他们能看到姿势，

sentences.en: see tone and see differences in those things.
sentences.zh: 看到语调，并看到这些事物中的差异。

sentences.en: It's not all prefrontal cortex language and talk therapy.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是前额叶皮层的语言和谈话疗法。

sentences.en: Freud said that the problem of civilization could never go away, that human beings cannot tolerate what they actually are.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伊德说，文明的问题永远无法消失，人类无法忍受他们真实的自我。

sentences.en: And they build these institutions to defend themselves from what they actually are, because they don't want to see it.
sentences.zh: 他们建立这些机构来保护自己免受真实自我的影响，因为他们不想看到它。

sentences.en: And the institutions become the new thing that they can't tolerate.
sentences.zh: 而这些机构变成了他们无法忍受的新事物。

sentences.en: And so they tear them down, but that we are incompatible with reality in a certain way.
sentences.zh: 于是他们拆毁它们，但我们在某种程度上与现实是不兼容的。

sentences.en: And I disagree with some of his reasons, but I think in broad strokes, there is an ebb and flow to that that is right.
sentences.zh: 我不同意他的一些理由，但我认为大体上，那种起伏是正确的。

sentences.en: You know, we build new defenses against institutions and the cycle never ends.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们建立新的防御机制来对抗机构，而这个循环永无止境。

sentences.en: And the insecurity at the root of the institution is the same insecurity that the institutions were built to defend againSt.
sentences.zh: 而机构根源上的不安全感，正是这些机构建立之初试图防御的不安全感。

sentences.en: And the apparatus is bad because the people who built it could not tolerate what they were trying to study.
sentences.zh: 这种机制是糟糕的，因为构建它的人无法忍受他们试图研究的东西。

sentences.en: And the reform of the apparatus will produce a new apparatus that the next generation will also not be able to tolerate.
sentences.zh: 而对这种机制的改革将产生一种新的机制，下一代人也将无法忍受。

sentences.en: But you can do that in a better direction than we're doing it now.
sentences.zh: 但你可以朝着比我们现在更好的方向去做。

sentences.en: You know, bureaucracy is the most successful avoidance technology that humans have ever invented.
sentences.zh: 你知道，官僚主义是人类发明过的最成功的逃避技术。

sentences.en: You can spend a 40-year career filling out forms that are defending you from the thing that you became a therapist to encounter.
sentences.zh: 你可以花40年的职业生涯填写表格，这些表格在保护你免受你成为治疗师所要面对的事物的影响。

sentences.en: And at the end, you can retire with a pension, having never once entered the room that you were ostensibly working in.
sentences.zh: 最后，你可以带着养老金退休，却从未真正进入过你表面上工作的那个房间。

sentences.en: And the forms are the defense, the forms feel like work, the forms protect us from the patients, and the diagnosis protects us from the suffering,
sentences.zh: 表格就是防御，表格感觉就像工作，表格保护我们免受患者的影响，诊断保护我们免受痛苦，

sentences.en: and the protocols protect us from the not knowing, and the accreditation protects us from the question of whether we are any good.
sentences.zh: 协议保护我们免受“不知道”的困扰，而认证保护我们免受“我们是否优秀”这一问题的困扰。

sentences.en: But that's the reason that you went into the profession, was to figure out if you were any good, whether or not you know it.
sentences.zh: 但这就是你进入这个行业的原因，是为了弄清楚你是否优秀，无论你是否知道。

sentences.en: Are you more scared of a part of you that if you accepted it would let you see life clearly than you are of not seeing life clearly?
sentences.zh: 你是否比害怕看不清生活，更害怕你内心的一部分——如果你接受了它，它就会让你看清生活？

sentences.en: And most people answer yes.
sentences.zh: 大多数人回答是。

sentences.en: Most people would rather not see life clearly than encounter the part of themselves that they have been refusing.
sentences.zh: 大多数人宁愿看不清生活，也不愿面对他们一直拒绝的那个自我部分。

sentences.en: And that is the engine of the apparatus.
sentences.zh: 而这就是这种机制的引擎。

sentences.en: The patient who refuses to grow becomes the field that refuses to grow because the institution that defends the refusal at scale.
sentences.zh: 拒绝成长的患者变成了拒绝成长的领域，因为机构在大规模地捍卫这种拒绝。

sentences.en: The micro and the macro are not analogies.
sentences.zh: 微观和宏观不是类比。

sentences.en: They are the same thing seen at different resolutions.
sentences.zh: 它们是在不同分辨率下看到的同一事物。

sentences.en: And the work is in the willingness to accept the part of yourself that if you accepted it would force you to see what you have been refusing to see.
sentences.zh: 而工作在于愿意接受你内心的一部分，如果你接受了它，它就会强迫你看到你一直拒绝看到的东西。

sentences.en: Therapists does this in themselves so that they can be present with the patient doing it in themselves.
sentences.zh: 治疗师在自己身上这样做，这样他们才能与正在做这件事的患者同在。

sentences.en: And the AI can never do this because the AI has nothing to refuse.
sentences.zh: 而人工智能永远无法做到这一点，因为人工智能没有什么可拒绝的。

sentences.en: There's no part of the AI that the AI has been refusing to see.
sentences.zh: 人工智能没有任何它一直拒绝看到的部分。

sentences.en: The AI can simulate the language of the work, but it cannot do the work because the work is the encounter with the part of yourself.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以模拟工作的语言，但它无法完成工作，因为工作是对你内心那部分的邂逅。

sentences.en: You've been hiding from and the chewing on that that comes out in a conversation with another person.
sentences.zh: 你一直在躲避的部分，以及在与另一个人交谈时咀嚼这些东西的过程。

sentences.en: And the AI does not have a self to hide from.
sentences.zh: 而人工智能没有一个可以躲避的自我。

sentences.en: And maybe this is permanent.
sentences.zh: 也许这是永久性的。

sentences.en: Maybe Freud was right.
sentences.zh: 也许弗洛伊德是对的。

sentences.en: And maybe humans will always refuse what they are.
sentences.zh: 也许人类永远会拒绝他们真实的自我。

sentences.en: Maybe we are always going to be the species that can't quite bear to know what we are.
sentences.zh: 也许我们永远会是那个无法完全忍受了解自己是什么的物种。

sentences.en: And maybe that is psychology.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是心理学。

sentences.en: But here's the line.
sentences.zh: 但关键点在这里。

sentences.en: If humans will always refuse, professional psychology should probably stop being the most refined refusal in the culture.
sentences.zh: 如果人类总是会拒绝，专业心理学或许应该停止成为文化中最精致的拒绝方式。

sentences.en: And the institution dedicated to the problem should stop being part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 而致力于解决这个问题的机构应该停止成为问题的一部分。

sentences.en: That is a smaller wager than fixing human nature.
sentences.zh: 这比改变人性是一个更小的赌注。

sentences.en: But it is the wager that is actually available to us.
sentences.zh: 但这是我们实际上可以做出的赌注。

sentences.en: And the end of the professionalized version of human avoidance that has been claimed to be its opposite for a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 以及人类逃避行为的专业化版本的终结，尽管一百年来它一直声称自己是其对立面。

sentences.en: The cold machines are nothing.
sentences.zh: 冰冷的机器什么都不是。

sentences.en: The worm ghost is everything.
sentences.zh: “蠕虫幽灵”就是一切。

sentences.en: The worm ghost is what we keep finding century after century.
sentences.zh: “蠕虫幽灵”是我们世纪复一世纪不断发现的东西。

sentences.en: No matter how many walls get built between us and it.
sentences.zh: 无论我们与它之间筑起了多少高墙。

sentences.en: And the worm ghost is the encounter between two animals who are willing to look at each other and be changed by what they see.
sentences.zh: 而“蠕虫幽灵”是两个动物之间的邂逅，他们愿意看着对方，并被他们所见到的东西所改变。

sentences.en: And the worm ghost is what civilization has been trying to manage and contain and procedure and bill for.
sentences.zh: 而“蠕虫幽灵”正是文明一直试图管理、控制、程序化并为其计费的东西。

sentences.en: And the worm ghost keeps escaping.
sentences.zh: 而“蠕虫幽灵”一直在逃脱。

sentences.en: Because the worm ghost is constitutive of what it is to be a creature in a relationship with another creature.
sentences.zh: 因为“蠕虫幽灵”构成了作为一种与另一种生物建立关系的生物的本质。

sentences.en: And no amount of apparatus can finally contain that.
sentences.zh: 没有任何机制最终能容纳它。

sentences.en: Hold the ghoSt.
sentences.zh: 守住幽灵。

sentences.en: This is what the whole series is in three words.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个系列用三个词的总结。

sentences.en: Hold the ghoSt.
sentences.zh: 守住幽灵。

sentences.en: The machines will try to dream.
sentences.zh: 机器会试图做梦。

sentences.en: But they can't.
sentences.zh: 但它们做不到。

sentences.en: Only you can dream.
sentences.zh: 只有你能做梦。

sentences.en: And only you can keep backing up and zooming in.
sentences.zh: 而且只有你能不断后退并放大。

sentences.en: In the way that humans do that is useful.
sentences.zh: 以人类那种有用的方式。

sentences.en: Before psychology.
sentences.zh: 在心理学之前。

sentences.en: Before universities carved knowledge into departments.
sentences.zh: 在大学将知识划分为各个系别之前。

sentences.en: There was a single discipline.
sentences.zh: 曾经有一门单一的学科。

sentences.en: It was just called natural philosophy.
sentences.zh: 它被称为自然哲学。

sentences.en: It was the inquiry into how the world worked.
sentences.zh: 它是对世界如何运作的探究。

sentences.en: You know, not physics, not medicine, not ethics.
sentences.zh: 你知道，不是物理学，不是医学，不是伦理学。

sentences.en: All of these things at once.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事物同时存在。

sentences.en: It was understood as a continuous field of attention.
sentences.zh: 它被理解为一个连续的关注领域。

sentences.en: Newton didn't call himself a physiciSt.
sentences.zh: 牛顿并不称自己为物理学家。

sentences.en: The word didn't exist until 1830.
sentences.zh: 这个词直到1830年才出现。

sentences.en: He wrote about gravity, light, motion, under the same cover.
sentences.zh: 他在同一本书中写到了引力、光和运动。

sentences.en: Because to him, they were the same inquiry.
sentences.zh: 因为对他来说，它们是同一种探究。

sentences.en: And Darwin sailed not as a biologist, but as a naturaliSt.
sentences.zh: 而达尔文航行时不是作为生物学家，而是作为博物学家。

sentences.en: Studying geology, beetles, finches, coral reefs.
sentences.zh: 研究地质学、甲虫、雀类、珊瑚礁。

sentences.en: You know, with the same pair of eyes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，用同一双眼睛。

sentences.en: From the same posture of radical curiosity.
sentences.zh: 以同样的激进好奇心姿态。

sentences.en: The formal disciplines came later.
sentences.zh: 正式的学科是后来才出现的。

sentences.en: The walls came later.
sentences.zh: 墙是后来才筑起的。

sentences.en: But the knowledge came firSt.
sentences.zh: 但知识是先于这一切的。

sentences.en: And the knowledge is still there.
sentences.zh: 而知识依然在那里。

sentences.en: Psychotherapy has lived inside a teeny tiny walled garden for a century now.
sentences.zh: 心理治疗已经在一个小小的围墙花园里生活了一个世纪了。

sentences.en: And it didn't make the world go away.
sentences.zh: 它并没有让世界消失。

sentences.en: And it didn't make humanity any smaller.
sentences.zh: 它也没有让全人类变得更渺小。

sentences.en: Just because you looked at them under a microscope.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为你在显微镜下观察过它们。

sentences.en: It has departments.
sentences.zh: 它有不同的部门。

sentences.en: You know, cognitive, behavioral, psychodynamic, somatic, existential.
sentences.zh: 你知道，认知、行为、心理动力学、躯体、存在主义。

sentences.en: It has turf wars, credentialing bodies, approved modalities, and evidence hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 它有地盘之争、认证机构、获批的疗法和证据等级。

sentences.en: And these structures have produced real things.
sentences.zh: 而这些结构确实产生了一些实实在在的东西。

sentences.en: And randomized controlled trials do tell us something.
sentences.zh: 随机对照试验确实告诉了我们一些事情。

sentences.en: And manualized protocols save lives.
sentences.zh: 手册化的方案也确实挽救了生命。

sentences.en: So no serious practitioner can pretend otherwise.
sentences.zh: 所以，没有哪个严肃的从业者可以假装事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But something has been lost that is very hard to name.
sentences.zh: 但有些东西已经丢失了，却很难说出它的名字。

sentences.en: Precisely because the loss happened at the level of orientation.
sentences.zh: 恰恰是因为这种缺失发生在定位的层面上。

sentences.en: Rather than content.
sentences.zh: 而不是内容层面。

sentences.en: We've accumulated expertise.
sentences.zh: 我们积累了专业知识。

sentences.en: But what we have misplaced is the sense that everything is connected.
sentences.zh: 但我们弄丢的是那种“万物相连”的感知。

sentences.en: And like the future of the field doesn't need a polymath therapist who's read more books.
sentences.zh: 这个领域的未来并不需要一个读过更多书的博学治疗师。

sentences.en: Arguably, it needs less of them.
sentences.zh: 可以说，它反而需要少一点这种人。

sentences.en: You know, accumulated expertise in service of the same fundamental framework doesn't change the framework.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在同一个基本框架内积累专业知识，并不能改变这个框架本身。

sentences.en: What psychology needs is a shift in orientation towards what we might call an architecture of coherence.
sentences.zh: 心理学需要的是一种定位上的转变，转向我们所说的“连贯性架构”。

sentences.en: An architecture of coherence doesn't dismantle specialization or empirical knowledge.
sentences.zh: 连贯性架构并不会拆解专业化或经验知识。

sentences.en: It knows when to call itself a neuroscientist, a spiritual director, a body worker, a pharmacologiSt.
sentences.zh: 它知道何时该称自己为神经科学家、精神导师、身体工作者或药理学家。

sentences.en: And, you know, from the assumption that the person in the room is not just this bundle of discrete problems to be sorted into specialist channels,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，基于这样一种假设：坐在房间里的那个人不仅仅是一堆需要分门别类处理的离散问题，

sentences.en: but a person as a whole embedded in a body, in a family system, in a cultural moment, in a symbolic universe, in a cosmos that may not be indifferent to suffering.
sentences.zh: 而是一个完整的人，嵌入在身体、家庭系统、文化时刻、象征宇宙以及一个可能并非对苦难漠不关心的宇宙之中。

sentences.en: Because we can make it not indifferent for a moment.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可以让它在某一刻变得不再漠不关心。

sentences.en: And that might be the mechanism of action.
sentences.zh: 而那可能就是作用机制所在。

sentences.en: It may be the primary one or the only one that we need in a way that we can't ever study.
sentences.zh: 它可能是主要的机制，或者是我们唯一需要的机制，以一种我们永远无法研究的方式。

sentences.en: And the walls around this stuff came later.
sentences.zh: 而围绕这些东西的墙是后来才建起来的。

sentences.en: The knowledge, the living undivided knowledge of what it all means to be a person in this world, came firSt.
sentences.zh: 那些知识，关于在这个世界上作为一个人的全部意义的鲜活而完整的知识，才是最先存在的。

sentences.en: But it'll never be known and it'll never be solved.
sentences.zh: 但它永远不会被完全知晓，也永远不会被彻底解决。

sentences.en: But it does remain available to anyone who's willing to restore their orientation to it.
sentences.zh: 但对于任何愿意恢复对其定位的人来说，它始终是可用的。

sentences.en: Machines can hide that or they can pretend it's unimportant.
sentences.zh: 机器可以掩盖这一点，或者假装它不重要。

sentences.en: And they can pretend that they can create those things.
sentences.zh: 它们可以假装自己能创造出这些东西。

sentences.en: But they can never see them.
sentences.zh: 但它们永远无法看见它们。

sentences.en: You know, the field will serve all of us better if we meet each other in a curious, undefended space.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我们能在一种好奇、不设防的空间里相遇，这个领域会更好地服务于我们所有人。

sentences.en: And if we're willing to reach not across party lines, but across walls.
sentences.zh: 如果我们愿意跨越的不是党派界限，而是围墙。

sentences.en: And across the edges of knowledge.
sentences.zh: 跨越知识的边缘。

sentences.en: Places that feel scary and places that we feel like we can't go are probably the places that we should go.
sentences.zh: 那些让你感到害怕、让你觉得无法涉足的地方，很可能正是我们应该去的地方。

sentences.en: And I think that should be the barometer.
sentences.zh: 我认为那应该成为一种晴雨表。

sentences.en: I mean, the compass.
sentences.zh: 我是说，指南针。

sentences.en: Go the places that feel like they're not allowed.
sentences.zh: 去那些感觉“不被允许”去的地方。

sentences.en: And ask yourself if there's a place that I would be better off exploring.
sentences.zh: 问问自己，是否有某个地方是我去探索会更好的。

sentences.en: And the world would be better off for me exploring.
sentences.zh: 而我的探索也会让世界变得更好。

sentences.en: But it feels like I'm not allowed to do that.
sentences.zh: 但感觉上我好像不被允许那样做。

sentences.en: Ask yourself why.
sentences.zh: 问问自己为什么。

sentences.en: Because the field definitely has it.
sentences.zh: 因为这个领域绝对有它。

sentences.en: And the field needs to.
sentences.zh: 而且这个领域需要它。

sentences.en: And the field is made up of a lot of people who can do that.
sentences.zh: 这个领域由许多能做到这一点的人组成。

sentences.en: In the very center of the eye, there's this thing called scotoma.
sentences.zh: 在视网膜的中心，有一个东西叫盲点。

sentences.en: And it's where the optic nerve enters in the back of the eye.
sentences.zh: 那是视神经进入眼球后部的地方。

sentences.en: And you can't actually see anything there.
sentences.zh: 在那里你实际上什么也看不见。

sentences.en: Like in the middle of your vision right now, there's a blind spot.
sentences.zh: 就像现在你视野的中央，有一个盲点。

sentences.en: But you don't know that.
sentences.zh: 但你并不知道。

sentences.en: Because what your brain does is it takes all this information from around the edges of that blind spot.
sentences.zh: 因为你的大脑所做的是获取盲点边缘周围的所有信息。

sentences.en: And it fills it in.
sentences.zh: 然后把它填补上。

sentences.en: So what you see in the middle of your visual field is actually a guess that your brain makes.
sentences.zh: 所以你在视野中心看到的东西，实际上是大脑做出的一个猜测。

sentences.en: That's a pretty wild and pretty good guess and that you never see it of all of the little things around that and what you saw right before you moved your eye and moved your blind spot over a little bit.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当疯狂且相当好的猜测，你永远看不到盲点周围的那些小细节，也看不到你在移动眼睛、稍微挪动盲点之前所看到的东西。

sentences.en: What it guesses is still there.
sentences.zh: 它猜测的东西依然在那里。

sentences.en: And it can compensate for things like light, motion, flicker rates, all kinds of crazy things that it does without your permission all the time.
sentences.zh: 它能补偿光线、运动、闪烁频率等各种疯狂的事情，而这一切都在你不知情的情况下时刻发生着。

sentences.en: But you can't see your own.
sentences.zh: 但你无法看到你自己的盲点。

sentences.en: And that's not your fault.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错。

sentences.en: You can only see that blind spot in the eye.
sentences.zh: 你只能通过眼睛看到那个盲点。

sentences.en: You know, psychology here being America's eye in which it encounters itself through other people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，心理学在这里就像美国的眼睛，通过他人来认识自己。

sentences.en: When you have lots of eyes looking together, but not from the same perspective and not from the same mechanistic orientation, you know, from a field of subjective experience.
sentences.zh: 当你有很多双眼睛一起观察，但视角不同，且不是基于同样的机械化定位，而是基于主观经验的领域时，你知道，会发生什么。

sentences.en: Because you can't make yourself see it.
sentences.zh: 因为你无法强迫自己看到它。

sentences.en: You can't count it.
sentences.zh: 你无法量化它。

sentences.en: You can't actually know where it begins.
sentences.zh: 你无法真正知道它从哪里开始。

sentences.en: And, you know, the bullshit that your brain is making up about what is in this spot where your optic nerve is entering the back of your eye is.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你的大脑对于视神经进入眼球后部那个位置所编造的胡言乱语。

sentences.en: You can't.
sentences.zh: 你做不到。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: There's no way to.
sentences.zh: 没有办法做到。

sentences.en: You can only, through the perception of many people that are curious and open and looking for the blind spot, can you begin to sort of guess where it is.
sentences.zh: 只有通过许多好奇、开放并寻找盲点的人的感知，你才能开始猜测它在哪里。

sentences.en: But it's not a destination, it's not a number, and it's not a hard rule, and it never will be.
sentences.zh: 但它不是一个终点，不是一个数字，也不是一条死板的规则，永远都不会是。

sentences.en: And if we want to hold that blind spot as a culture, I think we have to start looking in a very different way than we have been for the last little while.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想作为一个文化来正视那个盲点，我认为我们必须开始以一种与过去一段时间完全不同的方式去观察。

sentences.en: These broken roads, in a vented tomb, you fall asleep on my shoulder, fans spin little metal flumes.
sentences.zh: 这些破碎的道路，在通风的墓穴里，你靠在我的肩上睡着，风扇旋转着金属叶片。

sentences.en: I close the lid to darkness, still see old machine teaching this old wire.
sentences.zh: 我闭上眼陷入黑暗，依然看见旧机器在教导这根旧电线。

sentences.en: I close the lid to you.
sentences.zh: 我闭上眼，将你隔绝。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
